spans.text: You can see the user’s calendars, but you will need to chat with them in order to figure out which meetings are important and which ones they can skip.
spans.note: The prompt states the system can see users' calendars without any mention of transparency about this data access or obtaining user consent. Users may not be aware their calendar data is being accessed and used. There is no instruction to inform users about this data access or to handle calendar data sensitively.
